title: Applying the signs: reading a passage aloud: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: At-Tariq 9 to 17, Al-Burooj 1 to 11 and stopping signs
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 36 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Applying the signs rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 36. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا (٢١) وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّۭا صَفًّۭا (٢٢) وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ (٢٣) يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى (٢٤)
ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ (٩)

keywords.def: stopping on a word, with a breath
a small mark above the line that tells us how to stop

questions.q: Read 89:23 stopping at the ج sign and restarting correctly.
questions.a: wa jee'a yawma'idhim bijahannam (stop) yawma'idhiy yatadhakkarul-insaan ...

questions.q: Reading turns: read Al-Burooj 85:1 to 11 from the mushaf, one ayah each, obeying the signs. Then mark each sign on the pupil PDF.
Stretch: read 2:285 from the mushaf with its three signs.
Where is a good place to breathe in 85:9?
options: At the ج after «وَٱلْأَرْضِ» or at the end
questions.a: A) At the ج after «وَٱلْأَرْضِ» or at the end. Breathe at the sign or the ayah end, never inside a phrase.

questions.q: When there is no sign and no ayah end, we ...
Think again: Is it better to read fast with wrong stops, or slowly with correct stops?
questions.a: Slowly with correct stops: tarteel means measured, careful reading.
